'''Cacophanizer shells''' were artillery weapons used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. They were utilized at the [[Invasion of Begeren]] and the [[Battle of Ord Radama]]. Their effects could only be overcome through the use of a [[sonic damper]].
